card.name: Punctuation after opioid hypotension warnings
card.fires_on: Punctuation marks such as a closing parenthesis, comma, "and" or "e.g.," in opioid label warnings. They follow section references like (5.10) or terms such as hypotension and circulatory shock.

modes.label: Closing section reference
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a Warnings section number, just before the next section heading.
modes.example: Avoid use of APADAZ in patients with circulatory shock. ( 5.10<< )>> Risks of Use in Patients with Increased

modes.label: Joiners after hypotension or e.g.
modes.description: A comma, "and" or "e.g.," in a list of effects such as hypotension, respiratory depression and coma.
modes.example: can increase the risk of hypotension<<,>> respiratory depression, profound sedation, coma

modes.label: Comma before a Latin name
modes.description: A comma after a common animal name, before its Latin species name.
modes.example: They are Squirrel Treefrogs<<,>> Hyla squirella. The smaller
